reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing exported getScheduledAmount and routes the five inline midpoint computations through it.

duplication.why: All inline copies of the ranged-amount computation (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule, preview, forecast, schedule template) are deleted in favour of the one helper.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, the module both client and server already import for schedule amounts.

scope.why: Only the rule, its consolidation, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: A single small function now owns the expected amount, so the next rule change is a one-line edit.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, used by the client components, schedules/app.ts (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule), computeSchedulePreviewTransactions, forecast normalizeSchedule and budget schedule-template.
